hits.tldr: Official Prettier plugin automatically sorts Tailwind CSS classes in recommended order across editors.
Tailwind CSS scans source as plain text, so you must use complete class names and map dynamic values to predefined class lists.
CSS grid-rows utility classes for defining row templates with repeat, subgrid, and custom values.
Create custom CSS classes with theme variables instead of repeating utility classes in templating languages.
Use supports-[...] and not-supports-[...] variants to apply styles based on browser feature support.

content.text:
This repo (Tailwind CSS docs) doesn't cover prettier-plugin-tailwindcss internals or its issue tracker — no section in the local docs addresses class sorting across template literal interpolations.

The closest relevant doc is `src/docs/editor-setup.mdx` ("Class sorting with Prettier", lines 66–84), which only describes enabling the plugin, not its sorting algorithm for `${...}` expressions.

This behavior is a known limitation of prettier-plugin-tailwindcss (it sorts each static string segment between interpolations independently, since it can't reorder across dynamic expressions) — it's expected, not a config error, and isn't documented in this repository. You'd need to check that plugin's own repo/issues for confirmation.
